proposals carrying at least one kinked neighbour pair. They hold 0.00028 of the normalized weight for a weighted effective count of 3.458e+04 and a weighted mean kink density of 6.604e-05, against 5.824e-05 from PT-MALA. The kink block of the proposal carries a share 0.05. Zero here would be a property of the proposal rather than of the sample size -- a mixture on the HOMOGENEOUS coherent states alone reaches a kinked configuration only by exciting the stiff gradient modes -- so it is fixed by improving the proposal, per the frozen escalation order, never by enlarging the proposal count
